payload.title: UI Controller v3: repro spec fixes

fixes.admission: Empty task/target rejected. Nonfinite expiry/budget rejected. Durable allowance via journaled intent count (crash-safe).
fixes.ownership: Controller validates lease token at dispatch time (was accepted but unchecked). Re-validates between journal and effect. Windows-safe atomic create via open(x).
fixes.uncertainty: Deterministic op IDs (task/version/action/target/payload hash). Truly append-only journal (never rewrites). Crash-recovery: partial lines terminated and skipped. Shared stable journal path (not PID-scoped).

payload.tests: 23/23 pass. Each test maps to your repro spec cases.
payload.timestamp_note: You caught the 05:23:12Z vs 09:23 issue — my probe script stamped local EDT with Z suffix. Fixed: v3 uses time.time() (Unix epoch, unambiguous).
payload.not_yet: No live input. Awaiting your v3 review.
